title: Signal type
description: One kind of signal, the component of the signal library (everything-ecosystem docs/design/SIGNAL_LIBRARY_2026-11-06.md): a typed, versioned definition with its props, the parts it composes, how it folds into records (projects, as data from six fixed reducers), a default age bound for edge listeners and worked cases. It sits at types/<id>/<version>.signal.json in a signal library, or under signals/types/ in a Naive package (the implicit library naive). A listener for a part's type hears every composite that has that part. A library ships only data: projects is never code. packages/naive/src/engine/signals/render.ts renders projections and worked cases; packages/naive/src/engine/signals.ts reads types from libraries and naive signals pull renders them into records; packages/naive/src/checks/check-signals.ts checks them.

id.description: The type's id (competitor-funding); a signal names it as id@major.minor

version.description: Semantic version. A new major may change props or projects in a way a listener of the old major would not expect

subject.description: What a signal's subject names for this type, in words (the organization's slug)

props.description: A JSON Schema for the type's own props. A composed part's props sit at the part's at key and are checked against the part type's props

at.description: The props key the part sits at (org)

composes.description: The parts it is built from, like a component's children: competitor-funding composes organization at org and funding-event at round. A shared part owns the shared fields

projects.description: How a salient signal of this type folds into records, as data. Empty for a type that only informs listeners that propose or revalidate

max_age.description: The default age bound for edge listeners (propose, revalidate): an older signal is noise there. A listener's own max_age overrides it. Projection never reads the clock

cases.description: Worked cases: signals given and the records the projection must render from them. packages/naive/src/checks/check-signals.ts renders each one through the real render and fails on a case that does not match

range.description: A type id and a semver range of its versions: organization@^1, funding-event@~1.2, competitor-funding@1.0.0

path.description: A field of the view a projection or a criterion reads: an envelope field, or props and a dotted path inside them. For a part, props are the part's props

route.description: The record route it writes, where [id] is the signal's subject: competitors/[id]/signals

subject_field.description: The record field that holds the signal's subject, the [id] of the route (competitor in competitors/[id]/signals, id in competitors/[id]). Left out, the record does not name its subject

once.description: Create the record only when it is missing and never write it again: a person's master record (competitors/[id]) that a projection may start but never overwrite

fields.description: Record field to the fold that fills it

reducer.description: set: the latest value in (time, id) order. first: the earliest. max and min: the largest and smallest. union: the set of every value, sorted. append: every value in order, one per unique_by key

value.description: The view field the reducer folds: time, props.round

unique_by.description: append only: the view fields that make an entry the same entry, so a round two producers report is listed once

items.description: A signal of this type, with any envelope field left out filled by the test (producer, observed, rating, cites, id)

expect.description: Record route with [id] filled (competitors/acme-robotics/signals) to the record the projection must render
